question:
Study the given pie chart and answer the question that follows.

The pie chart shows the distribution (degree-wise) of the number of players who play five sports A, B, C, D, and E (assuming each player plays only one sport).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53f04f980ad1b2fb0ccbd11e07caf8716fea93f40ba87cc70066b87b4427a394.png] 

If the number of players who play sport C is 162, then the difference between the total number of players who play sports A and E is:
solution:
Calculation:

Sports C is 162

Sports C represents 54°

Difference between sports A & E = 90° - 72° = 18°

Number of the players represented by 18° = (162 ÷ 54) × 18 = 54

**∴ If the number of players who play sport C is 162, then the difference between the total number of players who play sports A and E is 54.**
